_why: Declared exceptions for `make acceptance-audit` (OI-ACCEPTANCE-PARSER-SCORES-ZERO-SILENTLY, AC-AP.3/AC-AP.4). An item lands here ONLY when its acceptance is genuinely present-but-not-enumerable and enumerating it is product/architect work an engineer may not do (process 12a). Per process 17h limb 1 every row carries a machine-checkable `authority` - an exclusion with no authority is a FINDING, not a sample - and the audit FAILS on a row whose finding has gone away, so this file can only shrink.
_shrink_only: Adding a row is a decision that needs an owner. Removing one is always allowed. A row that no longer matches a real finding FAILS the audit.
